newsitem.title: USA: Schuler Homes acquires Seattle homebuilder.
newsitem.headline: Schuler Homes acquires Seattle homebuilder.

text.p: Schuler Homes Inc Thursday announced the acquisition of 49 percent of Stafford Homes, a homebuilder in the Seattle/Puget Sound area of Washington.
Schuler Homes has an option to purchase the remaining 51 percent interest in Stafford.
Financial details of the deal were not disclosed.
Stafford focuses on entry-level, and first and second move-up markets. It builds homes ranging in size from about 1,000 to 3,000 square feet, priced from $105,000 to $350,000.
In the last year, it closed sales on about 170 homes, generating revenues of approximately $40 million.
